## Appearance

Uncle Saul is a plain-looking man with a tall, somewhat awkward frame that has become weak, stooped, and inclined slightly forward. He has a closely shaved, bronzed, and heavily furrowed face, complemented by deep-set, exceptionally blue eyes. His hair is thick, iron-gray, and noticeably grayer than before, hanging down to his shoulders as a mane.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P6](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P3](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P11](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0011)_

## Personality

Captain Saul is characterized by a splendid spirit, constant good humor, and a calm demeanor that resists anger. A philosophical man who is appreciative of beauty, he also has a penchant for interfering. In addition to being a fairly decent fiddle player, he is an exceptionally talented storyteller and natural narrator, though he harbors a strange dread of a drawn-out end.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P61](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0061), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P3](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), +4 more_

## History

Captain Saul, also known as Uncle Saul, welcomes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh to their new home and becomes a frequent presence in their lives, sharing stories of local history and his time at sea. Operating the [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse, he hosts gatherings where he introduces neighbors and entertains visitors with his collection of sea curiosities. He attends [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and other friends, engaging in lively debate, and welcomes the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) at the lighthouse surrounded by companions. Later, Saul comforts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during her grief over the loss of her newborn daughter, [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), and entrusts her with the story of his own long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). When [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) visits [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point), Saul realizes Adrian is the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md), lends him his personal life log, and agrees to let Adrian write a book based on his seafaring adventures and his lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). Saul later provides funds to [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) so she can travel to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery on her supposed brother Rufus. Following a [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) political victory, he contemplates his own mortality, asking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to care for his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), after he passes away. After bestowing a heartfelt blessing on Adrian and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) upon their engagement, Saul receives the printed copy of his life story, celebrating its arrival with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). The following morning, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discover that Captain Saul has peacefully passed away at the lighthouse with his book open on his chest.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), +42 more_

## Quotes

> "Nephew Hector. His understanding of it matches my own. Well, now, I am truly pleased that you invited me to remain for supper. My hunger is quite strong—I ate very little for dinner today."
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)

> "Listen, my usual way of living is royal. Up at the Glen yesterday evening, two pounds of steak were bought by me to bring back. Today, my intention was to enjoy an extraordinarily fine dinner."
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)

> "Indeed, I fear that is the case. I really dislike it. It gives me the impression that there might be something rather unnatural concerning myself."
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P42](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0042)

> “Probably—probably,” agreed Captain Saul. “That’s what I remarked to him back then. Thinking that was a great deal more reassuring. I disliked the thought of him perceiving stuff of that nature—it felt truly strange.”
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P16](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0016)

> "Those were the words he used. I recall them just as if it happened yesterday, even if I was not entirely sure what he intended to say. What is your guess about what he REALLY intended, doctor?"
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P20](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--uncle-saul.md)

Uncle Saul forms a close connection with [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduces them, realizing Adrian is the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md). Saul shares his seafaring stories and lends Adrian his life-book, leading Adrian to spend a summer at the lighthouse adapting Saul's memoirs into a manuscript. Their bond deepens over correspondence and shared outings, culminating in Saul offering a heartfelt blessing to Adrian and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) before his death.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), +18 more_

### [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ambrose--uncle-saul.md)
